describe.shard.config.ts: build entry: serialisable declaration plus output blobs/custom/platform sections; builds out/<slug>/
describe.fence-reads.json: the shard's reviewed list of files read during a boot fence
describe.mounts.json: the public files only this shard reads, which its product carries (scripts/record-shard-mounts.mjs)
describe.runtimeCost.json: the shard's measured runtime cost rows
describe.README.md: what the shard declares, its custom code and why, budgets, look, open work (its plan rows)
describe.manifest.json: authored discovery metadata; contains no runtime module
describe.ktx2.generated.ts: your KTX2 table, written by `bake-ktx2` once you bake KTX2 art. The one generated file you commit
describe.discovery.generated.ts: temporary generated discovery bridge; never hand-edit or commit it
describe.data/: build-time authoring inputs and erased JSON type contracts; executable build logic belongs in generators/
describe.generators/: build-time source that emits admitted JSON, WASM and named assets; never shipped as runtime TypeScript
describe.bake/: the shard's manual Node commands: an author runs them to rewrite committed bytes, and no build does. They stay out of generators/ because maps hash it
describe.assets/: source assets consumed by the build; assets/public/ holds files gen copies to public/assets/<slug>/ (scripts/shard-public.mjs)
describe.blender/: the shard's retained Blender build sources and offline rig checks (build-time only; optional)
describe.test/: optional source tests; never copied into the shipped product
describe.look/: authored data, source assets and generated outputs; executable TypeScript belongs in generators/
describe.quests/: authored data, source assets and generated outputs; executable TypeScript belongs in generators/
describe.thumbs/: authored data, source assets and generated outputs; executable TypeScript belongs in generators/
describe.explore/: authored data, source assets and generated outputs; executable TypeScript belongs in generators/
describe.boot/: authored data, source assets and generated outputs; executable TypeScript belongs in generators/
describe.creatures/: authored data, source assets and generated outputs; executable TypeScript belongs in generators/
describe.species/: authored data, source assets and generated outputs; executable TypeScript belongs in generators/
describe.quest/: authored data, source assets and generated outputs; executable TypeScript belongs in generators/
describe.world/: authored data, source assets and generated outputs; executable TypeScript belongs in generators/
describe.art/: the shard's mockup rounds (round-<n>-<label>/) and the data its look tools read; the build never reads them
